title: NoGapCode Golden Principle Enforcement Record
description: One entry per canonical principle (M7-D). Describes ENFORCEMENT CAPABILITY - whether the mechanism exists and is tested - not any specific project's compliance. Read by scripts/nogap_methodology.py; never consulted by the trust runtime itself (nogap.py) to make any decision. Editing this file changes only what is reported, never what is enforced.

classification.description: A = machine-enforceable trust/runtime invariant. B = workflow-enforceable methodology rule. C = advisory/optimization principle. Reused unchanged from methodology/principles.json - never re-derived here.

status.description: ENFORCED: a real mechanism exists, is active by default, and is tested end to end. PARTIAL: a real mechanism exists and is tested, but does not yet cover the full principle (a named future milestone completes it). DECLARED: the principle is represented (contract/schema/data) but no enforcement code exists yet. ADVISORY: intentionally never a hard gate, by design - status stays ADVISORY permanently, not a placeholder for future ENFORCED. DEFERRED: enforcement depends on a component that does not exist yet (e.g. Model Router).

scope.description: Which layer currently owns whatever enforcement exists. cross_cutting when both layers contribute.

owner_component.description: A known component identifier (see OWNER_COMPONENTS in nogap_methodology.py), or "none" if nothing implements this yet.

mechanism.description: One or two sentences: what actually happens today, stated plainly. Never describes a planned mechanism as if it exists.

evidence_kind.description: What kind of record would demonstrate this principle held for a specific case (e.g. "decision records", "transition_history"), or null if none exists yet.

implemented_by.description: File[:function] references. Each file must exist on disk - checked by the loader, not asserted here.

tests.description: Test file (optionally ::Class::test_name) references. Each file must exist on disk where given.

future_milestone.description: The milestone that would move this toward ENFORCED, or null if none is needed (ENFORCED already, or permanently ADVISORY).
